question: How should the plough be fastened to the yoke in its central position?
premises: The plough is bound in the middle of the yoke.
Its placement is not perfectly centered.
It is inclined somewhat to the right.
inference: After binding the plough in the middle of the yoke, it should be set slightly to the right.
plain_english: Having fastened the plough in the middle of the yoke, one should set it slightly inclined to the right.
